articles.title: Bitcoin slips to $78,800 as BNB and DeFi tokens buck the selloff
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell 0.42% since midnight UTC to $78,874, but the CoinDesk 20 rose 0.2% and the memecoin index gained 0.41% as BNB Chain tokens rallied.

articles.title: Stablecoins could save South Korean merchants up to $3.8 billion a year, budget office says
articles.snippet: South Korea’s budget office warned that stablecoin adoption could reduce banks' roles as credit intermediaries and potentially destabilize token pegs during mass redemptions.

articles.title: Is Bitcoin too volatile to risk your retirement on?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin believers see it as an almost certain long-term investment, but retirement demands a different approach. How much crypto exposure is too much for your retirement account?

articles.title: Circle to acquire Tazapay to expand USDC cross-border payments
articles.snippet: Tazapay processes $25 billion in annualized volume and offers payout rails across 100-plus markets, extending Circle’s USDC payments reach.

articles.title: Cronos confirms $9.2M slipped away before Tectonic exploit rollback
articles.snippet: Cronos’s post-mortem put the Tectonic exploit’s affected borrowing at $120.4 million, with 7.6% transferred off-network before validators intervened.
